paragraphs.text: Evereth , also known as Viceroy of Plunder , is a vampire soldier from an unknown plane.

Evereth is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Black Treasures decks . She is a light-skinned female vampire with brown hair and red eyes. She sits upon a throne and is potentially of Ixalan origin due to her appearance and title being similar to the conquistadors of the Legion of Dusk .
